definitions.explanation: Describes an appearance that is both beautiful and well-balanced. Often used for people with refined, elegant features, or for things with a clean, polished beauty.

examples.japanese: {端麗|たんれい}な{顔立|かおだ}ちの{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: She is a woman with graceful features.

examples.japanese: {容姿|ようし}{端麗|たんれい}な{俳優|はいゆう}が{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: A handsome actor became the talk of the town.

examples.japanese: この{日本酒|にほんしゅ}は{端麗|たんれい}な{味|あじ}わいで{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: This sake has a clean, refined flavor and is easy to drink.

notes:
{端麗|たんれい} describes beauty that is well-proportioned, refined, and elegant. A literary and formal word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {容姿|ようし}{端麗|たんれい}: beautiful appearance, good-looking (a set four-character phrase, very common)
- {端麗|たんれい}な{顔立|かおだ}ち: graceful, well-proportioned features

SAKE TERMINOLOGY:
- {端麗|たんれい}{辛口|からくち}: clean and dry (describes sake with a crisp, refined flavor)
- {淡麗|たんれい}: sometimes written with this kanji in sake contexts, emphasizing lightness

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Rarely used in casual conversation. Most commonly encountered in the compound {容姿|ようし}{端麗|たんれい}, which appears in written descriptions, formal contexts, and job/dating profile language.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美|うつく}しい: beautiful (general, common word)
- {麗|うるわ}しい: beautiful, lovely (literary)
- {端正|たんせい}: neat and orderly in appearance (similar formality, slightly different nuance emphasizing orderliness)
